codes.validation_failed: Some data is not valid. Check it and try again.
codes.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
codes.not_found: This item was not found (it may have been deleted, or you are not a member).
codes.conflict: This cannot be done because the data conflicts (for example a duplicate name or an archived project).
codes.email_taken: An account with this e-mail already exists. Try signing in instead.
codes.invalid_credentials: The e-mail or password is wrong.
codes.invitation_invalid: This invitation link can no longer be used (expired, cancelled or already used).
codes.last_owner: There must always be at least one owner.
codes.personal_workspace: This cannot be done in a personal workspace. Create a company workspace first.
codes.unprocessable: This data cannot be calculated, so it was not saved.
codes.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
codes.internal: The server had a problem. Try again.
codes.otp_invalid: The code is wrong or has expired. Request a new code and try again.
codes.ai_unavailable: The AI assistant is not available right now. Try again later.
codes.ai_quota: The AI assistant has no credits left. Contact your administrator.
codes.network_error: Cannot reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
codes.invalid_response: The server sent an invalid answer.
